verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about Terraform Cloud/Enterprise offering region or data-residency selection for where state, run data, or telemetry is stored; all evidence is about CLI plan/apply/state mechanics and provider ecosystem, not the product's own data storage location choices. Missing for 10: any documentation of Terraform Cloud regional deployment options, self-hosted/on-prem data residency controls, or explicit region-selection settings for stored state/data.
